name: Button
purpose: Triggers an action. Offers six visual emphasis levels and five accent colors.

parts.name: container
parts.description: Inline, centered row holding content with 8px gap between children; fully rounded to the large radius.

variants.name: variant
variants.description: primary = solid accent fill, white text. secondary = no fill, accent-colored text, light accent tint on hover. outline = transparent with 1px border and foreground text, muted fill on hover. ghost = transparent with muted-foreground text, secondary fill and foreground text on hover. destructive = destructive fill with destructive-foreground text, slightly translucent on hover. icon = padding only (8px all sides), no fill or color of its own.

variants.name: color
variants.description: Accent used by primary and secondary only; other variants ignore it.

states: focus-visible (2px ring with 2px offset against page background)
layout: Padding is 16px horizontal and 8px vertical for every variant except icon.
Sizes to its content; does not stretch unless placed in a stretching container.
constraints: Primary text is always white regardless of accent.
Default is primary orange, not blue.
accessibility: Native button semantics; operable with Enter and Space.
Icon-only usage needs an accessible name.
Visible focus ring only for keyboard focus.

name: ToggleButton
purpose: A button that holds an on/off pressed state.

parts.name: container
parts.description: Inline row with 8px gap, 16px by 8px padding, large radius, 1px border, secondary fill.

variants.name: color
variants.description: Accent applied to fill and border when selected; text becomes white.

accessibility: Exposes pressed state to assistive technology.

name: Link

parts.name: text
parts.description: Inline anchor text, underlined on hover, small rounded focus ring.

variants.name: color
variants.description: Accent text color with the matching hover shade; default uses foreground and turns muted-foreground on hover.

accessibility: Real anchor with href for navigation.

name: Breadcrumbs
purpose: Shows the path to the current page.

parts.name: item
parts.description: A link followed by a separator, except the last.

states: ancestor item: muted-foreground, turns blue on hover, underline on focus
constraints: The last item is marked as the current page and ignores pointer input.
accessibility: Navigation landmark with ordered path semantics.
Current item announced as current page.

name: Tabs
purpose: Switches between panels of related content; one panel visible at a time.

parts.name: tab-bar
parts.description: Horizontal row of tabs with a 1px bottom border.

parts.name: tab
parts.description: Label with 16px by 8px padding, 14px text, transparent 2px bottom border.

parts.name: panel
parts.description: Content area with 16px padding and 14px foreground text.

variants.name: tab color
variants.description: Color of selected tab's underline and text.

accessibility: Tab list, tab, and tab panel roles with selection state.
Arrow-key navigation within the tab list.

name: Menu
purpose: A trigger that opens a popover list of actions.

parts.name: trigger
parts.description: Any button supplied by the consumer.

parts.name: popover
parts.description: Floating panel, minimum width 12rem, popover fill, 1px border, large radius, large shadow, clipped corners.

parts.name: item
parts.description: Row with 12px gap between optional leading icon and label; 12px by 8px padding; small radius.

variants.name: item variant
variants.description: Destructive items use destructive text and a faint destructive tint on hover and focus.

variants.name: item hover color
variants.description: Hover and keyboard focus show the light accent fill with accent text.

layout: List padded by 4px inside the popover.
constraints: Opens on trigger press; Escape closes.
accessibility: Arrow keys move focus; typeahead supported; focus returns to trigger on close.
